title: impl_string_enum_serde! is private to submission.rs — new string enum authors have no shared pattern
description: A contributor adding a new string-enum type to mailbox.rs or any other module will not know about the macro in submission.rs (it is module-private). They will either (a) write the same macro again, (b) hand-code three impl blocks like MailboxRole does, or (c) discover the macro by accident. The maintenance consequence is continued divergence: some enums use the macro, some do not, with no discoverable rule. Fix: move to src/string_enum.rs, pub(crate), document that all new string enums must use it.
